candidates.claim: The VENDOR_VPN ACL, applied to vendor VPN traffic via vpn-filter, has as its first entry a permit of tcp/3389 from 172.16.50.0/24 to SCADA server 10.10.10.20 in OT, so vendor users can open a direct connection into the OT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:82 so vendor traffic reaches only the jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389.

candidates.claim: Vendor VPN traffic to OT is permitted by the VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82, which is outside the approved VENDOR service (A7, jump host 10.10.20.30 only).
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:82 so that vendor VPN users can reach only the jump host.

candidates.claim: The access-list VENDOR_VPN entry at fw-01:82 is not in the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the entry against the approved baseline and remove it unless an approved change record covers it.

clarifications.question: Inter-switch trunks carry VLAN 10 on sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24 and on sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and Gi1/0/24. Should the rule that only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10 be read as exempting these approved trunks?

fw-01 is an ASA with asa_http_server enabled (fw-01:110), limited to MGMT on the mgmt interface for ASDM. Does the rule that IOS HTTP/HTTPS servers must be disabled apply to this ASA setting, or is ASDM over HTTPS on fw-01 permitted as device management?
